How to Play

  • Drag a piece from the tray onto the board — or tap it, then tap the spot where you think it goes.
  • Right spot? It clicks into place. Wrong spot? It just bounces back — no penalty.
  • Tap or drag a placed piece any time to pick it back up.
  • Use Show Edge Pieces to spot the frame pieces first — that's the easiest place to start.
  • On Hard puzzles, the board's empty-slot outlines are hidden by default — tap Show Grid anytime if you want them back.
